content_sections.heading: ESIC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ESIC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ESIC Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 29 vacancies are available - 6 for Professor, 11 for Associate Professor, 7 for Assistant Professor and 5 for Senior Resident - 3 Year.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ESIC Faculty and Senior Resident posts is scheduled from 25th August 2026 to 27th August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend within this period.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 29 vacancies are available for Faculty and Senior Resident posts at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pune.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this ESIC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online; they must appear directly for the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the ESIC posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for the posts is as per the guidelines of the National Medical Commission (NMC erstwhile MCI).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: For Senior Resident (3 Year) posts, the maximum age limit is 68 years. For Senior Resident (1 Year) posts, the maximum age limit is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Professor post?
faq.answer: The approximate emoluments for the Professor post are around ₹2,57,000, with a basic pay of ₹1,23,100.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates, ESIC (Contractual Employees), Female, Defence Ex-servicemen, and PH candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring duly filled application form, application fee receipt (if applicable), and all relevant original documents with self-attested copies, including ID proof and educational certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bibvewadi, Pune, Maharashtra, 411037.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these ESIC posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications followed by an interview.
